title: AI Solutions Architect | Enterprise AI Outcomes
summary: AI solutions architect with 15+ years across enterprise platforms, software delivery, QA, and automation. Delivered $1.7M+ in operational savings and increased internal AI adoption from 47% to 97% at Assent through production GenAI systems. Founded a consultancy delivering 120+ GenAI applications for 30+ clients. Combines multi-model architecture, RAG, agentic workflows, and governance with experience coordinating business and engineering teams and managing enterprise platforms at scale.
